sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:166408
Court No. - 72

Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 9280 of 2023
Applicant :- Mohd. Usman

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Deepak Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Amit Rai, Advocate holding brief of Sri Deepak Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri S.P. Pandey, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as perused the record.
3.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Complaint No.40 of 2022, registered under Sections 498A, 452, 323, 377, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.
Act at Police Station- Haldaur, District Bijnor with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail.

Mohd. Usman vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65199777/

entities.text: Mohd. Usman vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, on 21.03.2021, the marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the complainant as per Muslim Rites.
The applicant is stated to have subjected her to cruelty for demand of dowry and is even stated to have committed unnatural offence with her besides assaulting her and outraging her modesty.
There are other serious allegations against other family members of the applicant.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The present complaint case has been filed after a much delay and there is no explanation of the said delay caused.
There is no injury report to corroborate the prosecution story.
Learned counsel has further stated that the summoning order dated 26.09.2022 is cryptic and without application of mind.
The present complaint case is the clear misuse of the dowry laws.
Several other submissions have been made on behalf of the applicant to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against him.
The circumstances which, as per counsel, led to the false implication of the applicant have also been touched upon at length.
There are no criminal antecedents of the applicant.
The applicant has apprehension of his arrest.

Learned counsel for the applicant undertakes that he has co-operated in the investigation and is ready to do so in trial also failing which the State can move appropriate application for cancellation of anticipatory bail.
6. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the anticipatory bail application but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant.

7. On due consideration to the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and considering the nature of accusations and antecedents of the applicant, the applicant is liable to be enlarged on anticipatory bail in view of the judgment of Supreme Court in the case of "Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1".

entities.text: Sushila Aggarwal Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2020) 5 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The future contingencies regarding the anticipatory bail being granted to applicant shall also be taken care of as per the aforesaid judgment of the Apex Court.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

entities.text: Mohd. Usman vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 9. It is made clear that observations made hereinabove are exclusively for deciding the instant anticipatory bail application and shall not affect the trial.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023 Ravi Kant (Krishan Pahal, J.)
